name: topo
description: Daily-run Topo workflows for sequences, inbox, tasks, and account briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Run Topo sequences, inbox, tasks, and account briefs from chat
interface.longDescription: Install Topo once to connect the MCP server and load daily-run skills: record outreach outcomes, triage replies, review waiting leads, clear tasks, start outreach, create a sequence, source new leads, suppress targets, brief an account, diagnose a quiet sequence, and pause or resume sending.
defaultPrompt: Sarah Chen booked a meeting — take her off the sequence.

Find me 50 VPs of Sales in France.
Brief me on this account before my call.
